reference_format.note: DC/NNNNNN — a 6-digit serial, with no year element and no type suffix.

quirks.summary: File GETs are session-gated, not Referer-gated.
quirks.detail: With the search session's cookie jar and no Referer a file GET returns 200; a fresh jar carrying the documents-tab Referer returns 404.
quirks.workaround: Carry the search session's cookie jar through to every file GET (Recipe C sends both jar and Referer in any case).

quirks.summary: The advanced search offers no 'application received' date filter; use date(applicationValidatedStart/End) instead.
quirks.detail: Posting date(applicationReceivedStart) to an install that does not offer it returns HTTP 500, which reads as a portal fault rather than a bad parameter. Fields present: appealDecision, applicationCommittee, applicationDecision, applicationValidated.
quirks.workaround: Read the date field names off the advanced search form before posting.

robots.note: robots.txt disallows the search path for our UA

source_notes: MIGRATED off Northgate Planning Explorer to Idox (old /Northgate/PlanningExplorer/ 403s to a council error page; PlanIt scraper_type correctly updated — staleness is per-council). FOURTH Idox base path: /PlanningData-live/. Recipe C verbatim otherwise; exact-ref search lands on the detail page directly. Non-PDF files lack the /pdf/ segment, same as Leeds. File GETs SESSION-GATED (session-no-Referer 200; fresh-jar-with-Referer 404). Ref format DC/NNNNNN (6-digit serial, no year/type). No WAF. PlanIt omits docs_url on applications it has seen 0 documents for.
